Thanks Ben — helpful recap. A few notes from procurement/finance side: 

- Acme typically issues POs for software, but Finance has a threshold: POs are only processed for vendor spend >= $50,000 annually. For smaller deals we usually pay by card or prepay (works better operationally).
- We try to centralize purchases through AWS Marketplace when possible, but certain regulated teams (like Search & Insights) require vendor attestation that prevents marketplace billing until we've completed additional vendor onboarding. That adds ~2-3 weeks.
- We cannot sign upfront multi-year committed contracts without Legal review; on the procurement side, Net30 invoicing is standard, but several business units require prepay for first invoice while vendor onboarding completes.

Edge-case: For small pilots (< $25k) Finance will not issue a PO and will not approve prepay unless vendor is already in their vendor portal. That means we often need either: (A) process by corporate card, or (B) get a one-off PO exception approved by Procurement leadership.

I'll run this by Karen in finance and Diego in procurement. Can you confirm what the minimum billing cadence and invoice frequencies are on Redwood's side, and whether you can accept credit card payments for an initial pilot? Also please attach your standard vendor questionnaire and SOC2 if available.

Thanks,
Sonia
